named_subject: a snake (rattlesnake) with its head raised to the left and its tail held upright on the right
action: The snake holds a raised, coiled pose with a slight head and body sway, and from frame 11 onward flicks a forked tongue out of its mouth in changing directions.
identity_gap: The S-shaped double-line body, small eye tick, blunt head and forked tongue match the doodle, but the animation adds a closed triangular rattle at the tail that the doodle does not have.
notes: The body sway and the tongue flicks in frames 11-16 follow the film, but the tongue appears fully extended in frame 11 and swings from pointing down-left to pointing up between frames 15 and 16 with no in-between position. Adding in-between tongue positions (partly extended, mid-swing) would help most.
